claim_rules: Read each assigned submission fully before consulting prior targeted dispositions. Extract factual assertions potentially affecting policy cost, benefit, need, safety, feasibility or legal scope, regardless of citation. Include sufficiently specific proposed-draft/current-law descriptions; distinguish proposals from descriptions.

Split materially different propositions; merge repetitions within one document. Retain within-document page/section locators and short exact original-language anchors, with concise English paraphrases.
List excluded normative statements, forecasts and low-priority descriptive matter with page ranges and reasons. Audit all pages for omitted material claims.

Assess independent primary evidence even when an author citation is accurate. Check source definitions, cohorts, dates, instrument applicability and methods. Archive public evidence with URL, access time and hash when possible; record denied access.

Evaluate claims as of authored date; distinguish contemporaneous text from later snapshots. Missing standards or missing evidence do not establish falsehood. Exact draft identity, amendment date and contemporaneous applicability must remain qualified when unverified.

Materiality high: a correction could alter central policy rationale; medium: significant supporting factual premise; low: incidental detail. Direction relative to author request is separate from severity.
No policy disagreement, prediction, unsupported assertion, or lack of accessible evidence alone becomes an error. Do not infer intent or invent author responses.

Fresh peer independently re-read all assigned counterpart author pages, repeat evidence checks, and look for omissions. Reviews are of claims and non-findings, not only proposed errors. Preserve disagreement and adjudication.
No author contact. No human specialist confirmation. Technical paywalls are access limits, not findings.

User explicitly asks for conservative assessments: if primary evidence, version identity, time basis, definitions, actual wording or context is insufficient, retain unresolved and do not admit a finding.
Supported must apply to the recorded proposition, not a silently weakened substitute. Split a supported narrow fact from an unresolved stronger claim only when needed and explain the relationship.

Record pure forecasts, preferences and rhetorical statements in page-based exclusions rather than manufacturing factual errors or inflating the unresolved inventory. Separate conditional empirical mechanisms from prediction of outcomes.
Use short contiguous exact source-language excerpt anchors (no ellipses or silently compacted identifiers); quote precisely, locate physical PDF pages including covers.
Document time-sensitive comparisons as of authored date, and acknowledge covers/letters/versions and current metadata disagreements. Use later evidence only with explicit temporal limits.
Initial inventories are frozen before counterpart review. Each peer re-reads the entire counterpart document allocation, checks all outcomes and audits omissions; no peer edits the raw inventory.
